text: Peak Saunas Limited Lifetime Warranty: residential use only, original purchaser, non-transferable, auto-registered at order. "Lifetime" = the expected life of the component, defined as 7 years under normal residential use. Indoor and outdoor carry the same terms.
note: Stated policy — quote exactly. Page explicitly instructs agents to state it this way and do NOT say '10-year'.

text: Labor of any kind — diagnosis, service, or installation — is never covered on any component. The warranty covers parts only.
note: Stated policy, exact terms. Important guardrail: do not imply full-service coverage in ad copy.

text: Coverage by component: Heating elements — Lifetime (=7yr residential). Cabinetry & wood structure — Lifetime (=7yr residential). Red light therapy (RLT) panel — 3 years (NOT the lifetime tier; corrected by Austin 2026-09-07). Control system & power supply — 3 years. Chromotherapy lighting — 1 year. Sound system — 1 year. Accessories (cup holders, thermometers, etc.) — 1 year. WiFi/app connectivity — 1 year.
note: Stated policy, exact terms. Do not market the RLT panel or electronics as carrying the same lifetime coverage as structure/heating elements — recent correction (2026-09-07) demoted RLT panel to the 3-year tier.

text: Not covered: normal wear/discoloration/fading/cosmetic change; misuse/abuse/neglect/improper install; commercial or rental use (separate commercial warranty available); unauthorized parts or modifications; freight/shipping for replacement parts after 90 days from delivery; weather, water, power surges, pests, Acts of God.
note: Stated policy, exact terms — useful for FAQ/objection-handling sections, not typically headline copy.

text: Free shipping, always (continental US). Ships in a PeakGuard custom protective wooden crate from the Ontario, California warehouse via freight/LTL (no single primary carrier — a large carrier network).

text: In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days; they then arrive 5–14 business days from the ship date. Carrier calls 1–2 days before delivery to schedule a 4-hour appointment window. Curbside standard delivery (white-glove/garage available for an extra fee).

text: Visible damage at delivery: photograph it, note it on the delivery receipt/BOL, may refuse shipment, then contact support. Concealed/hidden damage: must be reported within 48 hours of delivery (with photos) — claims made after 48 hours cannot be honored.
note: Stated policy, exact terms — for FAQ/trust sections, not headline ad copy.
